'''Red Six''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the sixth member of Red Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Red Six.

==History==
A [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Red Six as a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]]. While [[Rebellion on Felucia|pursuing]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] over [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], "Red Six" claimed to be unimpressed by the size of the Separatist [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|dreadnought]] [[Subjugator (Subjugator-class)|''Sujugator'']], prompting a rebuke from Zane for grandstanding.<ref name="Kinect" />

[[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]] used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] when he flew with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] on a [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|mission to Commenor]] and during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="XWRS.5">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]]</ref> Jek was killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] when his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] was destroyed by the [[Space station/Legends|space station's]] guns.<ref name="ANH" /> Instrumental in success of strafing attacks against the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] the X-wing starfighter skipped last inspection of computer and flight control systems.

After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] flew an X-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] as Red Six on a reconnaissance mission, during which he destroyed the [[Kuat Facility]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

At the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], another [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] flew under the call sign Red Six, reporting to [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] that the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] commander had picked up a tailing enemy [[Starship/Legends|ship]], before discovering that an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fighter squadron was launching an attack on the Alliance's [[Redemption/Legends|medical frigate]].<ref name="ROTJ">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode VI: ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>
